notes:
Row capacity is 168 HP per row, not 84: measured from the photo, not assumed. The trim reads 'A-100 ANALOG MODULAR SYSTEM / DOEPFER' twice per edge (a double-width case), and three independent checks agree: Doepfer A-196, A-138 and A-180 panels (8, 8, 4 HP) give ~17.3 px/HP in row 0, the eleven 12 HP Analogue Systems panels in rows 1-2 give ~18.1 px/HP, and each full row (0, 1, 2) is 168 HP wall to wall at those scales. There is no centre divider (the A-155 spans HP 84-134).
Geometry: strong keystone (case wider at the bottom; panel edges lean ~0.115 px/px at the left, ~0.09 at the right) and a small left-to-right scale change (~3%). Positions were measured at a top and a bottom band per row, fitted as x = a + b*h + c*h^2 per band (residuals <= 4 px, ~0.2 HP, on rows 0-2), and the overlay draws quadrilaterals. px_per_hp is the mid-row average.
Row 3 is not full: panels total 162 HP. A ~3 HP opening at HP 152-155 (between the second RS-170 and the A-181) shows a lit PCB, red LEDs and a ribbon cable behind the rail but no front panel, so it is unlabelled per the empty-rail rule; the owner may want to check whether it is a panel-less module. The other 3 HP of slack is sub-HP gaps rounded into 1 HP at 60, 139 and 167 (panels there sit on half-HP positions; worst rounding is ~0.6 HP).
RS-60 (n 20, 21, 26): identity is certain from the panel; the catalog has only 'RS-60N Envelope' (id 1459), which the maker's own page describes as having a new faceplate. Left open_set because the catalog keeps old and N revisions as separate rows elsewhere (RS-180/RS-180N, RS-110/RS-110N). If the owner treats RS-60N as covering the RS-60, change these three to maker 'Analogue Systems', name 'RS-60N Envelope'.
A-180 (n 7, 47): old 'A180 MULTIPLES' panel mapped to catalog 'A-180-1': Doepfer's own A-180 page lists A-180-1 as the 4 HP, eight-socket passive multiple, which matches the panel. Medium because the printed name ('A180') is not the catalog name.
A-138 (n 6): old 'A-138 MIXER' panel (A-138a/b family, exp marked); open_set because the only catalog row, 'A-138m', is per Doepfer's page a 4x4 Matrix Mixer. Side note on the catalog itself: Doepfer gives the A-138m as 20 HP, the catalog says 8 (not a photo disagreement, no A-138m on this photo).
Catalog module_type for 'RS-20' is LFO, but the RS-20 on the photo is a ring modulator + multiple; the name matches so it is labelled RS-20.
Flash hot spot washes out text in the centre of rows 2-3 (RS-290, second RS-110, the Plan B Model 10 title); all but the Model 10 number were still legible at full resolution.
Every width and the row capacity are measured on the photo; the RS-60N, A-138m and A-180-1 facts are from analoguesystems.co.uk and doepfer.de; identities are read from the panels and matched to catalog.json.
